notes.subject: ויהודה הגלו
notes.rationale: KJV/ASV: 'Yehuda ol i go kalaput' (Yehuda i stap subyek) o 'ol i go kalaput ... na Yehuda' (Yehuda i stap long list bilong buk) — Tok Pisin i bihainim namba wan pasin.

notes.subject: הגלו
notes.rationale: Hibru i tok 'kalaput/rausim olgeta' — Tok Pisin 'go kalaput long' i holim piksa bilong eksail.

notes.subject: genealogies
notes.rationale: Ves em i wan long kaunim nem bilong ol man — stori bilong olkain.

translation: Na olgeta man bilong Yisrael ol i raunim ol nem bilong ol olsem stori bilong ol; na luk, ol i stap olraiting long buk bilong ol king bilong Yisrael na Yehuda; ol i go kalaput long Bavel long pasin bilong giamanim ol i wokim.

tokens.gloss: ol i raunim ol nem bilong ol olsem stori bilong ol
long pasin bilong giamanim ol i wokim
